أختبئ (form VIII)
# أَخْتَبِئُ (ʔaḵtabiʔu) /ʔax.ta.bi.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# أَخْتَبِئَ (ʔaḵtabiʔa) /ʔax.ta.bi.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# أَخْتَبِئْ (ʔaḵtabiʔ) /ʔax.ta.biʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
